toegepas.voor: en ander klink as jy oor hulle skraap
toegepas.na: en ander instrumente klink as jy oor hulle skraap
toegepas.rede_vinder: Straight after the singular 'n Ratel, 'ander' can read as other rattles; naming instrumente makes the reference clear.
toegepas.fout: Straight after the singular 'n Ratel, 'ander' can be read as other rattles rather than other instruments.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming 'instrumente' removes the ambiguity, parallels 'Party instrumente' two clauses earlier, and adds nothing.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Sorteer' needs an object here; the protected 'ewe goeie maniere' stays intact.
toegepas.fout: 'maniere om te sorteer' leaves the transitive verb without an object, which reads loose.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'om instrumente te sorteer' gives the verb its object without moving the meaning, and the protected 'ewe goeie maniere' stays intact.

laat_vaar.na: uitgehol sodat dit soos 'n ronde pot lyk
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Uithol tot 'n pot' reads wooden; saying it ends up looking like a round pot is more natural and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Uitgehol tot 'n ronde pot' is natural and says the body becomes a pot shape; 'sodat dit soos 'n ronde pot lyk' is longer and weakens that to merely looking like one.

laat_vaar.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
laat_vaar.voor: 'n Speler hou een in elke hand
laat_vaar.na: 'n Speler hou een kalbas in elke hand
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The previous sentence speaks of one hosho, so 'een' has no clear antecedent; naming the kalbas shows there are two.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'een' points back cleanly to 'n droë kalbas' in the previous sentence; adding 'kalbas' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar.voor: Die hosho hoort weer by die kokonratels as jy vra hoe die klank gemaak word, want albei word geskud.
laat_vaar.na: As jy vra hoe die klank gemaak word, hoort die hosho weer by die kokonratels, want albei word geskud.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: Putting the sorting question first mirrors the previous sentence (Volgens voorkoms ...) and makes the contrast clearer.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original already flows and 'weer' signals the contrast; the reorder is lateral.

laat_vaar.voor: binne die familie en nie drie families nie
laat_vaar.na: binne die familie, nie drie families nie
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: A contrast with 'nie' reads more naturally without 'en'; same meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'en nie drie families nie' is correct, natural Afrikaans; the comma version only reads differently.

laat_vaar.voor: sê of die maat gelyk gebly het
laat_vaar.na: sê of julle maat gehou het
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Maat hou' is the established Afrikaans idiom for keeping time; 'die maat het gelyk gebly' is wooden.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The proposal shifts the subject from the meter to 'julle' against the singular 'jou' of the previous sentence, and 'julle maat' can be read by a Grade 4 learner as 'your friend'.

na_skrywer.rede_vinder: 'Los laat' is easily read as 'loslaat' (let go of); 'laat verslap' says plainly that the muscles relax.
na_skrywer.fout: In a glossary definition, 'los laat' can be misread as 'loslaat' (let go of) rather than relaxing the muscles.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The point is real, but rewording a [begrip] definition beyond a plain spelling fix belongs to the writer.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: The NIE list is split into single characters (t, w, e, e, -, ...), not whole wordings. If the script checks forbidden wordings against that list, single letters such as 'e' or 'n' would count as forbidden and could block almost any change. Looks like a tooling fault.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Die instrumente in 'n familie is nie regtig familie van mekaar nie.
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Same fault: the NIE list is split into single characters instead of the intended forbidden wording (probably 'enige herskrywing wat die woordspeling of regtig verwyder').

Same character split in the NIE list ('H, i, e, r, ...' instead of 'Hier by ons'). Also, the protected wording does not occur verbatim in the lesson: the text reads 'Party dansers in Suid-Afrika bind ratels'. That keeps the point of the entry (Suid-Afrika, not 'hier by ons'), so it was not changed, but the entry may be stale.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: kom van die Shona en die Ndebele van Zimbabwe
laat_vaar_vorige.na: kom van die Shona en die Ndebele in Zimbabwe
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Avoids the repeated 'van ... van' chain; meaning unchanged.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: A preposition swap for style only; 'van Zimbabwe' matches the shared hosho wording and the original reads naturally.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die hosho van die Shona en die Ndebele
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Two stacked attributive adjectives read more naturally with a comma than with 'en'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'n hoë en droë klank' is natural Afrikaans; the comma form is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'binne-in' is the natural form at the end of the phrase and matches the hosho block.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'met sand of klippies binne' is idiomatic (the shared hosho definition uses the same form); lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'woorde uit hierdie les' is the natural preposition for words taken from the lesson.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'die woorde van hierdie les' is natural; swapping to 'uit' is a lateral preposition change.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'gedroog' is the simpler, more natural verb form than 'droog gemaak'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'droog gemaak' is correct, plain Afrikaans, and this is a glossary definition, so a stylistic rewording is not worth it.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: so lank duur soos twee kwartnote
laat_vaar_vorige.na: so lank duur as twee kwartnote
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The comparison of equality is 'so ... as' in Afrikaans, as the kwartnoot entry already has it; 'so ... soos' is wrong.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The halwenoot definition is protected word for word, and both 'so ... soos' and 'so ... as' are accepted Afrikaans, so this is not a fault.
